artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel comforting a figure in a dark, shadowy landscape. The scene is composed of intricate lines creating a sense of depth and texture, with a delicate interplay of light and shadow. An angel is depicted leaning forward, offering solace to a seated figure. The background suggests an outdoor setting with hills and a building silhouetted against a dramatic sky. In the foreground, a few more figures can be faintly discerned. The detailed line work and use of chiaroscuro give the drawing a dynamic quality.

artworks.title: Lady Hamilton as Nature
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after George Romney
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting with a small dog in her arms. She is looking directly at the viewer, with a serene expression and a slight smile. Her hair is styled up and tied at the back with a ribbon or cloth. She is dressed in a low-cut dress with long sleeves. The background features an outdoor scene with trees and subtle cloud formations.

artworks.title: Christ at Emmaus: the Larger Plate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of four figures gathered around a table. The central figure is seated at the table, surrounded by three standing figures. The table is adorned with food items, and the area behind the central figure is heavily shadowed. The figures are dressed in period attire, and the scene has a sense of narrative. The use of cross-hatching and fine lines creates a textured and detailed atmosphere, typical of the detailed craftsmanship of etchings.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with the Cat and Snake
artworks.description: This print shows a seated woman holding a small child in her arms. She is leaning slightly forward, the child's face pressed to her face. The woman's facial features are hard to identify against the crosshatching gray lines on her skin, but it seems as if her eyes are closed, and her hair is covered with a cloth or headscarf. She wears a long, simple dress with sleeves. The child's body is mostly obscured by the woman's arms, but its face is turned towards us, and it appears to be smiling slightly. On the left, a cat or similar animal is seated on a cushion or ledge. Behind the woman is a window, and the room is cluttered with other furniture including a chair, an open chest, and what may be a fireplace in the bottom right corner. Outside the window, a man is visible, with short hair and a beard. He appears to be looking into the room. Curtains hang down on the walls, and stairs lead downward in the bottom left corner. A halo-like circle seems to surround the head of the woman, and rays of light radiate from her. Upon closer inspection, a snake is visible emerging from the skirts of the woman, its tongue outstretched.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt: Crossing a Brook
artworks.description: This detailed etching depicts two individuals and a donkey. One figure, a woman, is seated on the donkey while holding an infant. The second figure, an older man, is walking with a staff. The landscape is filled with intricate foliage and trees, with a winding path.

artworks.title: Christ Crucified between the Two Thieves (The Three Crosses)
artworks.description: The image depicts a crucifixion scene with the central figure on a cross. Various individuals, some on horseback, are shown observing the scene. The composition employs dramatic contrasts of light and shadow, spotlighting the central figure. The lines convey depth and emotion, with a mix of sharp and soft detailing adding dynamism. The crowd is portrayed with various reactions, contributing to emotional depth. The atmosphere is somber, reflecting the seriousness of the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with Three Gabled Cottages beside a Road
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with thatched-roof cottages clustered on the left side. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a low horizon and a large tree dominating the right side. The detailed brushstrokes emphasize the foliage of the tree and the texture of the roofs. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, gray, and white for contrast. In the distance, additional structures can be seen.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Leaning on a Stone Sill
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21 x 16.8 cm (8 1/4 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a man from the waist up, his body turned to the left and his head facing us, with his bent arm resting on a ledge or low wall. The man has pale skin, long, curly hair, and a curving mustache with a pointed beard. He wears a soft hat on his head at an angle, and he is dressed in a textured robe with decorative patterns. The man has a furrowed brow and a neutral expression. The background is plain, and the print is signed "Rembrandt 1639" at the top left.

artworks.title: The Three Trees
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: Printed with deep, black shadows and swirling or straight lines on cream-white paper, three trees stand on a grassy bank alongside a body of water, probably a river or canal, in this horizontal etching, engraving, and drypoint. The grassy bank reaches almost two-thirds of the way across the composition from the right edge. At least two people, a horse-drawn wagon or carriage filled with more people, and a town, all minuscule in scale, are tucked under or beyond the trees. The face of the bank directly opposite us is dark in shadow, and the details of plants and the waterline are hard to make out. The bank tapers down so the distant horizon, which comes about a third of the way up the composition, stretches across the left half of the print. One person sits and one stands, fishing, by the water in the lower left corner. People work and cows stand or lie in the flat field beyond the water. Buildings and windmills created with a few strokes of the burin or etching needle are tiny in the far distance. The deeply shaded three trees are outlined starkly against the white sky. Dark clouds pour across the top of the sheet and enter along the left edge, and diagonal lines across the top left corner suggests falling rain. The artist signed and dated the print among grasses in the lower left corner of the printed image: “Rembrandt f. 1643.”

artworks.title: Philippe le Roy, Lord of Ravels
artworks.description: The image depicts an artistic sketch showing the upper portion of a man's body from the shoulders up. He is facing slightly to his right with direct eye contact. The man has a mustache and a small goatee, wavy hair parted to the left side, with curls framing his face and waves falling to his shoulders. He wears a dark garment with fur lining around the collar and ornate detailing. The background is plain. At the bottom, the name "Philippe Le Roy" is handwritten.

artworks.title: The Milkmaid
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.4 x 15.6 cm (4 1/2 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with cattle and rustic surroundings. It features three cows standing in the foreground, with a wooden fence in the background, along with trees and branches. The ground beneath the cows is rugged with scattered stones and dirt. The artwork resembles traditional engravings, with fine lines detailing textures.

artworks.title: Tourelle de la Rue de la Tixéranderie, Paris (House with a Turret, Weavers' Street, Paris)
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 25.2 × 13.8 cm (9 15/16 × 5 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling city corner with tall, intricate buildings. Viewed from street level, the buildings appear towering and detailed. The composition lacks a visible horizon line, with architectural features dominating. The style features precise linework, resembling an etching, emphasizing textures like brickwork and shingle roofing. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia and black shades, creating an aged look. Smoke rises from chimneys against a sky filled with fine line clouds. Figures near us provide scale and liveliness.

artworks.title: Le stryge (The Vampire)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gargoyle overlooking a cityscape with a tower in the background. The gargoyle is detailed and perched on a ledge, while the city below is depicted with rows of buildings leading towards a distant towering structure. Birds are depicted mid-flight in the sky. The drawing captures a sense of antiquity and observation. The line work is detailed, highlighting the gargoyle and the cityscape.

artworks.title: Allegory of War and Peace
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene depicting a landscape with various activities and objects. The image is divided into two panels. On the left panel, there are figures gathered near a table with plates, a cup, and a kettle, surrounded by foliage and a detailed tree. The right panel features figures engaging in tasks, with animals present. In the background are structures resembling buildings and castles on a hilly landscape. The scene conveys a sense of busy activity, possibly symbolic or narrative, reflecting themes found in medieval imagery. The woodcut style suggests an era of medieval allegory with detailed linearity and symbolism in daily life settings.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Meeting of Pope Paul II and Emperor Frederick III
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, yellow, tan, and orange on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 41.3 x 29.2 cm (16 1/4 x 11 1/2 in.)
sheet: 38.4 x 28.8 cm (15 1/8 x 11 5/16 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a complex composition of overlapping lines and shapes forming an abstract design. Two crowned figures are balancing on a large wheel, with one holding a scale. There are abstract elements resembling a medieval ship with a hull and oars, and architectural shapes like castles or fortresses on either side. Sun-like rays emanate from the top right. The scene conveys an allegorical depiction involving hierarchy and guidance, with human figures, symbols, and text.

artworks.title: Queen Katherine's Dream
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor heightened with white and gold over graphite
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring small, floating people ascending in a spiral, with one woman in the center, looking up at them. She is reclining on a couch or bed, and has her arms raised. She wears a pale blue dress and a white cloth over her long hair. The swirling figures emerge from the ground and rise upwards, creating a dynamic movement. They appear to be dancing, some holding instruments or baskets. Two of them appear to place a crown on the central woman. At the left and right edges of the bed are two seated figures who both appear to sleep in their chairs. On the left is a man with long white hair and a long white beard who wears a teal robe, and on the right is another woman who wears a yellow-green dress and has dark hair. Both of these people have their heads resting in their hands, with their elbows on the arms of their chair. The women and the floating people have blue-white skin, and the man on the left has pale peach skin.

artworks.title: Marin Cureau de La Chambre
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a person depicted from the waist up. The person is positioned facing slightly to the side, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have curly, shoulder-length hair. Their facial features include a prominent nose and a mustache. The individual is wearing a hat and an elaborate outfit with a high, wide collar and pleated and buttoned clothing. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Marin Cureau de la Chambre
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarters view with long, curly hair, a mustache, and detailed facial features. He wears a cap, formal attire with a decorative collar and voluminous sleeves. The attire is shaded to suggest silky fabric. He is enclosed in an oval frame with an inscription and a coat of arms below. The background has fine lines for texture.

artworks.title: The Weary Ploughman
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral setting with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is higher in the image with hilly terrains and a night sky above. A bright moon illuminates the scene. Detailed linework depicts a farmer with oxen and a dog on a rustic path. In the distance, a house with smoke coming out of the chimney can be seen. The style features fine etching lines for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, creating deep contrasts. The composition is balanced, guiding the viewer's eye from right to left.

artworks.title: Allegory of Spring (Allegorie des Frühlings)
artworks.artist: Christian Friedrich Sprinck after Philipp Otto Runge
artworks.description: Two panels depict richly detailed allegorical scenes. The left panel features a central female figure seated on elaborate scrollwork resembling a cloud and floral throne. Above float two cherubic figures, one holding a globe and the other offering a laurel. Below sit two cherubic figures surrounded by plants and fruits. The right panel shows a monumental female figure on an elevated throne, surrounded by cherubic figures. She gestures with one hand, with a radiating sun and celestial globe above her. Symbolic objects like a skull, a mask, and an urn lie at her feet, set on a patterned floor. The panels are framed with intricate decoration, and a central column divides them, displaying celestial motifs like the sun, moon, and stars.

artworks.title: Saint Bonaventure Arriving and Preaching in Lyon
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in vermilion, orange-rose, light and dark gray-blue, and lavender
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a central circular motif filled with various figures, surrounded by an ornate border. The figures in the painting are dressed in robes and displayed with symbolic items and banners with inscriptions. The color palette consists of red, blue, and earth tones, giving it a vintage appearance. The style resembles that of medieval or early Renaissance religious artwork, reminiscent of illuminated manuscripts and altarpieces. The detailed patterns and iconographic symbols suggest the influence of an artist skilled in richly detailed and symbolic compositions.

artworks.title: Woman in a Cape (La femme à la pèlerine)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the upper body upward, slightly to the side with their head turned towards the viewer in a partial profile view. The facial features are softly rendered, with a faintly defined face and closed eyes, framed by light hair against a darker background. The person wears voluminous dark clothing, possibly a cloak or heavy garment. There are no visible objects, jewelry, or setting in the monochrome, textured background.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of England
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a bust portrait of a person facing forward, with a slight turn to their left. The person has a long, oval-shaped face with prominent cheekbones, a slightly downturned mouth, and large eyes. Their hair is styled with a crown and jewels. They are wearing a high-collared garment with lace ruffles around the neck, richly decorated with patterns, pearls, and gemstones. The person also wears an elaborate necklace with a decorative pendant. The background is simple and neutral, and the portrait is enclosed within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Shield of Queen Elizabeth
artworks.medium: engraving pulled from silver medal engraved by  the artist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic coat of arms. The image shows an ornate coat of arms featuring a crowned shield supported by a lion on the right and a dragon on the left, both standing on their hind legs. The shield contains four quadrants, two adorned by three lions each and two by three fleur-de-lis. Above the shield is a large royal crown topped with a decorative cross. Encircling the central elements is a band with the Latin phrase "HONI SOIT QUI MAL Y PENSE," and surrounding the entire emblem is a wider band with the motto "DIEU ET MON DROIT".
